verified_facts.text: The resort sits between the Arabian Gulf, the terracotta desert and the Hajar Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled between the Arabian Gulf, terracotta desert, and the Hajar Mountains

verified_facts.text: The resort is about 45 minutes from Dubai.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers private island living with white-sand beaches.

verified_facts.text: Classic Sea View Rooms are designed with Arabian decor and have Gulf views.

verified_facts.text: Classic Sea View Rooms have a private balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step onto your private balcony and breathe in the warm coastal breeze.

verified_facts.text: Classic Sea View Rooms have smart-room technology.

verified_facts.text: The resort has beachfront private pool villas and seafront villas set in gardens steps from the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover enchanting beachfront private pool villas and seafront villas amid our lush gardens, just steps from the white sandy beach.

verified_facts.text: Each villa offers in-villa dining and room for family and friends.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each villa offers beautiful living spaces, in-villa dining, and sophisticated amenities with ample room for family and friends.

verified_facts.excerpt: Later in the afternoon, relax with shisha and take a front seat to a spectacular sunset show.
